Het CRM-overzicht toont ongelezen berichten. Werk ze bij zodat deadlines en opleveringen niet blijven liggen.

  • Focus of this article: unread, messages, crm
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Go to the TripleZero iT client panel. Keep this article (“How do I view unread messages from the CRM overview”) beside you so you only make the intended change.
  2. Sign in to the TripleZero iT client panel.
  3. Open Domains, Products, Invoices or Tickets — whatever fits unread.
  4. Perform the action for “How do I view unread messages from the CRM overview” (status, order, WHOIS, cancel or ticket facts).
  5. Check confirmation email or panel status for messages.
  6. Document what you changed around unread, messages, crm (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for unread, messages, crm matches “How do I view unread messages from the CRM overview”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside unread messages crm
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get unread, messages, crm right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if unread, messages, crm touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
